changelog: **Notification templates — data layer (#1718):** new `NotificationTemplate` (`orgId` + `TENANT_MODELS`, `@@unique([orgId, programId, eventKey, locale])`, `programId = ''` for the org-wide row) and `resolveTemplate()` in `src/lib/notifications/templates.ts`: programme row → org row → the dictionary's `notifications.events.<key>` code default, per recipient locale (a missing locale is the code default in that language, never another language's row). The renderer `src/lib/notifications/templateRender.ts` treats a stored template as untrusted: the body is rebuilt from a tag/attribute allowlist (http/https/mailto links or exactly `{{brand.url}}`, every text run escaped), merge tags are the event's `params` plus `brand.name` / `brand.url` / `recipient.firstName` (anything else literal), values are escaped after sanitising, and a row with an empty or unknown-tag subject, an empty body or a render error falls back to the code default with the reason. No rows are seeded; the editor is #1719. Doc: `docs/notification-templates.md`.
